title: Syntax and indentation

spans.text: WHY USE THIS?
Syntax and indentation mark code-block boundaries; a mistake can prevent a route or condition from running.
CORE EXPLANATION
Python uses indentation to define blocks. Lines in one block must use consistent indentation; four spaces are conventional.

spans.title: Watch out
spans.text: A name is not a copy of its value; mutations to a shared list or dictionary are visible through every alias.
COMMON MISTAKES
Distinguish a variable name, indentation, and comment: whitespace affects syntax, while comments explain intent.
